issues.detail: Hebrew 'וָאֶדֹּם' (from דמם) means 'I was silent/kept silent', not '我雖被染紅' ('though I was dyed red'). The Chinese mistranslates the verb, changing the meaning.

Hebrew 'לֹא אֵצֵא פָתַח' means 'I would not go out of the door' (i.e., I did not leave my door), not '卻不從門而出' which is acceptable, but the main issue is the preceding clause. The overall sense of silence/restraint is lost.
